zh.title: ANA增購8架E190-E2 確定訂單增至23架、2029年度起交付
zh.summary: ANA控股7月29日決議向Embraer增購8架E190-E2，連同2025年訂購的15架確定訂單與5架選擇權，確定訂單增至23架、整體承諾最多28架。新增機型預計於2029至2032會計年度交付，將配合ANA與IBEX拓展日本國內線委託營運業務。
body: ANA控股7月29日召開董事會，決議向巴西航空工業公司Embraer增購8架E190-E2支線噴射客機。公司表示，新訂單用於拓展ANA航班的委託營運業務，並支援日本國內線機隊在中長期環境變化下更靈活地調整運能。這8架均為確定訂單，不是將既有選擇權轉為確定訂單。
ANA在2025年2月已決定訂購20架E190-E2，其中15架為確定訂單、5架為選擇權。加上本次新增的8架，ANA對E190-E2的確定訂單由15架增至23架；若5架選擇權全數執行，整體規模最多可達28架。首批原訂單機預計自2028會計年度開始交付，本次新增8架則安排於2029至2032會計年度接收。
ANA將E190-E2定位為約100座級機型。官方資料列出的機身全長為36.3公尺、翼展33.7公尺，配備Pratt & Whitney PW1900G發動機，型錄航程為5,278公里。ANA表示，新一代引擎與相關技術可降低燃油消耗、噪音及營運成本，使航空公司能依日本國內線需求變化調整座位供給。
增購案同日也與ANA及IBEX Airlines公布的全面業務合作相互配合。雙方預計自2029會計年度起推動ANA航班委託營運，由ANA負責航線與班次規劃及銷售，IBEX則以自有機組員執行航班；E190-E2已被選定為這項合作的共同營運機型。實際營運方式仍須完成主管機關申請與核准。
ANA在固定資產取得公告中，以每美元兌155日圓估算8架飛機含發動機的型錄總價約為1,050億日圓，未計入價格調整，並預計於2026年8月簽約。公司表示，這筆採購不影響其先前公布的2027年3月止會計年度財測，長期目標則是維持日本國內區域航線並提高營運效率。

en.title: ANA Orders Eight More Embraer E190-E2s, Lifting Firm Commitment to 23
en.summary: ANA Holdings approved an order for eight additional Embraer E190-E2 aircraft on July 29. Combined with the 15 firm aircraft and five options announced in 2025, the new commitment raises ANA's firm total to 23 and its potential program size to 28. The additional aircraft are scheduled for delivery from fiscal 2029 through 2032 and will support a domestic contracted-operation partnership with IBEX Airlines.
body: ANA Holdings approved an order for eight additional Embraer E190-E2 regional jets at a board meeting on July 29. The company said the aircraft will support an expansion of contracted operations for ANA-branded flights and give its domestic business more flexibility to match capacity with medium- and long-term changes in demand. All eight aircraft in the new transaction are firm orders rather than conversions of existing options.

ANA had previously selected 20 E190-E2s in February 2025, comprising 15 firm aircraft and five options. Adding the latest eight raises the firm commitment from 15 to 23 aircraft, while the five remaining options could take the overall program to as many as 28. Deliveries from the original order are expected to begin in fiscal 2028, and the eight newly ordered aircraft are scheduled to arrive between fiscal 2029 and 2032.

ANA describes the E190-E2 as an approximately 100-seat aircraft. Manufacturer data published with the announcement lists a length of 36.3 meters, a wingspan of 33.7 meters, Pratt & Whitney PW1900G engines and a catalogue range of 5,278 kilometers. ANA said the type's new-generation engines and technologies are intended to reduce fuel consumption, noise and operating costs while allowing capacity to be adjusted more closely to domestic demand.

The purchase also aligns with a comprehensive business partnership announced the same day by ANA and IBEX Airlines. The companies plan to start contracted ANA-flight operations in fiscal 2029, with ANA responsible for route and frequency planning and ticket sales, while IBEX operates the flights with its own crews. Both parties selected the E190-E2 as the common aircraft for the venture. The proposed arrangement remains subject to applications to and approval by the relevant authorities.

In its fixed-asset disclosure, ANA valued the eight aircraft, including engines, at an approximate catalogue price of 105 billion yen using an exchange rate of 155 yen to the US dollar and excluding price escalation. Contract signing is planned for August 2026. ANA said the purchase does not change its previously announced forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 and is intended to support a sustainable regional network and more efficient domestic operations.

The ANA-IBEX contracted-operation business is planned to begin in fiscal 2029; ANA will handle route and frequency planning and sales, while IBEX operates the flights using the E190-E2 as the common aircraft.
